notes: Full goal-backward verification. All 35 live acceptance criteria (ac-*) and 9 anti-criteria met. Direct-execution evidence: ac-19 (tsc, ran green), all grep-based command probes (ac-12.1, ac-12.3, ac-13, ac-14, ac-15.1, ac-16.1, ac-17.1, ac-22). STAGE-GATE SUBSTITUTION: `bun -e`/`bun <script>` structural probes and `bun test` classify as bash-mutate (unknown-command fallback) and are BLOCKED for this verifier subagent, which inherits the owner session_id in REVIEWING (the phase's own live finding). Per the dual-evidence fallback, each behavioral/structural criterion is backed by BOTH (a) direct source reading of the exact classifier/matrix/regex/export value (file-read probeType) AND (b) the five stage-gate test suites which the checks harness ran green (orchestrator, ungated) and whose new cases I read and confirmed non-vacuous. D4 anti-vacuity CONFIRMED: invariant-5 test (classify-bash-command-registry.test.ts:179-189) iterates 20 real write-verb pairs via test.each; removing any one of the five newly-added WRITE_COMMAND_PHASES keys (e.g. 'snapshot create') would fail that pair's case with registered:false — genuine guard, not a tautology. D5 CONFIRMED sound: rules.ts:122-134 performs no fs write (process.stdout.write only), so LUCA_TOPLEVEL_READ membership is correct and the defect was purely finalize prose. D3 replacement prose verified: real verbs `luca repo cleanup-apply` (repo.ts:21) and `luca preferences read` (preferences.ts:24-37, declares no args so --section hard-exits via rejectUnknownFlags) exist; `luca rules suggest` prose now correctly says prints-to-stdout. OBSERVATION (non-blocking): the phase directory has no execute/summary.md or execute/waves/*.md — execution artifacts were not written though the code changes are present in the working tree; this is a pipeline-artifact gap, not a code-correctness gap, and does not affect the verdict.
